access_links.label: Electricity demand on the openmod wiki

description: Federal Grid Company is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Electricity demand > Russia", published or maintained by so-cdu.ru (publisher inferred from the link). Historical hourly load (updated every hour) for Russia's unified electricity transmission grid system is provided by Russia's Federal Grid Company. Data can be downloaded in csv or xml format limited to 24 hours (full day) per download. Profiles are available for the unified grid as a whole or per subregion. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Electricity demand" lists it under "Russia". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
